metadata.title: Overdetermined equations and support functions on the hyperbolic and de Sitter planes
metadata.abstract: We study overdetermined equations on the hyperbolic and de Sitter planes by means of the support-function representation of zero mean curvature surfaces in Lorentz--Minkowski three-space. On the hyperbolic plane, solutions of $\Delta u-2u=0$ give rise to branched spacelike maximal surfaces. We prove that, on a bounded simply connected domain, nontrivial constant Dirichlet and Neumann data force the domain to be a geodesic disk, provided that the associated support quadric is nonlightlike; moreover, the solution is a multiple of the hyperbolic cosine of the distance from the center. On the de Sitter plane, the corresponding equation is the Klein--Gordon equation $\Box u+2u=0$, and its solutions generate timelike minimal surfaces wherever the support tensor is nondegenerate. We identify the support quadric and the constant-angle condition determined by constant Cauchy data, prove that local rigidity fails along every analytic noncharacteristic curve, and recover rotational symmetry from constant data on a global Cauchy circle. Thus the same support-function formalism reveals a sharp transition from elliptic rigidity to hyperbolic flexibility when the signature changes.

analysis.topic: 几何分析、几何 PDE 与几何流
analysis.workSummary: 通过支撑函数把双曲及 de Sitter 平面的超定方程联系到 Lorentz–Minkowski 空间中的零平均曲率曲面。
analysis.breakthrough: 同一表示揭示椭圆型的区域刚性与双曲型的局部柔性。
analysis.limitations: 双曲平面刚性需非类光支撑二次曲面；de Sitter 局部与全局 Cauchy 条件不可混同。仅依据官方英文摘要及作者评论，尚未核查正文与完整证明；技术说明仅限摘要明确的信息，关键结论需回查原文。AI 披露另见独立核查记录；未检索到声明不代表没有使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。

analysis.priorityReason: 方法有跨几何 PDE 的启发性，条件与反例结构值得细读。
